decisions.reason: The shared 7 cm and 17 cm block-pareo border measurements are already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The block-pareo border measurements do not apply to the basket-weave print; its separate no-border decision is already represented by its own same-message MODIFY.
The 7 cm and 17 cm measurements concern the block-colour pareos, not the zebra print; the zebra selection and no-border changes are already represented separately.
Confirming the block-pareo border measurements does not change the general production-file standard, printing method, fabric, colour workflow, or ICC-profile requirement.

The candidate's independently applicable 1.5 cm seam allowance and rolled-hem purpose are already captured by its same-message MODIFY; the 7 cm and 17 cm values are block-pareo border widths rather than omitted artwork-dimension attributes.
The block-pareo border measurements do not alter the technical-sheet colour-reference documentation requirement, whose same-message acceptance concerns CMYK and Pantone information.
